27984-ralph-gurney-s-oil-speculation.title: Ralph Gurney S Oil Speculation
27984-ralph-gurney-s-oil-speculation.creator: Unknown
27984-ralph-gurney-s-oil-speculation.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Up here there is more excitement to it than you are aware of, and before you have finished your vacation, you will say that the life of a civil engineer in the oil fields of Pennsylvania is not by any means monotonous.

arxiv-2004-02569.title: Gradient-Based Training and Pruning of Radial Basis Function Networks with an Application in Materials Physics
arxiv-2004-02569.creator: Jussi Määttä, Viacheslav Bazaliy, Jyri Kimari, Flyura Djurabekova, Kai Nordlund, Teemu Roos
arxiv-2004-02569.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jussi Määttä, Viacheslav Bazaliy, Jyri Kimari, Flyura Djurabekova, Kai Nordlund, Teemu Roos. Many applications, especially in physics and other sciences, call for easily interpretable and robust machine learning techniques. We propose a fully gradient-based technique for training radial basis function networks with an efficient and scalable open-source implementation. We derive novel closed-form optimization criteria for pruning the models for continuous as well as binary data which arise in a challenging real-world material physics problem.

arxiv-2004-06424.title: Coupled cluster theory in materials science
arxiv-2004-06424.creator: Igor Ying Zhang 1 , and Andreas Grüneis 2,∗
arxiv-2004-06424.description: Abstract The workhorse method of computational materials science is undeniably density functional theory (DFT) in the Kohn-Sham framework of approximate exchange and correlation energy functionals. However, the need for highly accurate electronic structure theory calculations in materials science motivates the further development and exploration of alternative as well as complementary techniques.

arxiv-2101-03676.title: Ultrafast 3.5 µm fiber laser Journal: osajournal Publication type: Letter
arxiv-2101-03676.creator: Nathaniel Bawden, \authormark 1,* Ori Henderson-Sapir, \authormark 1,2 Stuart D. Jackson, \authormark 3 and David J. Ottaway \authormark 1
arxiv-2101-03676.description: Abstract We report the first mode-locked fiber laser to operate in the femtosecond regime well beyond 3 µm. The laser uses dual-wavelength pumping and non-linear polarisation rotation to produce 3.5 µm wavelength pulses with minimum duration of 580 fs at a repetition rate of 68 MHz. The pulse energy is 3.2 nJ, corresponding to a peak power of 5.5 kW.

arxiv-2104-06928.title: CONSTRAINING THE NEUTRON STAR MASS–RADIUS RELATION AND DENSE MATTER EQUATION OF STATE WITH NICER . III. MODEL DESCRIPTION AND VERIFICATION OF PARAMETER ESTIMATION CODES Facilities: NICER Python/C language ( Oliphant 2007 ) , GNU Scientific Library ( Gough 2009 ) , Cython ( Behnel et al. 2011 ) , Sci
arxiv-2104-06928.creator: Slavko Bogdanov, Alexander J. Dittmann, Wynn C. G. Ho, Frederick K. Lamb, Simin Mahmoodifar, M. Coleman Miller, Sharon M. Morsink, Thomas E. Riley, Tod E. Strohmayer, Anna L. Watts, Devarshi Choudhury, Sebastien Guillot, Alice K. Harding, Paul S. Ray, Zorawar Wadiasingh, Michael T. Wolff, Craig B. M
arxiv-2104-06928.description: Abstract We describe the X-ray pulse profile models we use, and how we use them, to analyze Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer ( NICER ) observations of rotation-powered millisecond pulsars to obtain information about the mass-radius relation of neutron stars and the equation of state of the dense matter in their cores.

arxiv-2105-13178.title: Global rigidity of the period mapping
arxiv-2105-13178.creator: Benson Farb
arxiv-2105-13178.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Let \mathcal{M}_{g} denote the moduli space of smooth, genus g\geq 1 curves and let \mathcal{A}_{h} denote the moduli space of h -dimensional, principally polarized abelian varieties. Let \J:\mathcal{M}_{g}\to\mathcal{A}_{g} denote the period mapping , assigning to a Riemann surface X\in\mathcal{M}_{g} its Jacobian variety together with the prinicipal polarization induced from the intersection form on H_{1}(X;\mathbb{Z}) .

arxiv-2105-14931.title: Document Domain Randomization for Deep Learning Document Layout Extraction
arxiv-2105-14931.creator: Meng Ling, Jian Chen, Torsten Möller, Petra Isenberg, Tobias Isenberg, Michael Sedlmair, Robert S. Laramee, Han-Wei Shen, Jian Wu, C. Lee Giles
arxiv-2105-14931.description: Abstract We present d ocument d omain r andomization (DDR), the first successful transfer of CNNs trained only on graphically rendered pseudo-paper pages to real-world document segmentation. DDR renders pseudo-document pages by modeling randomized textual and non-textual contents of interest, with user-defined layout and font styles to support joint learning of fine-grained classes.

arxiv-2106-06324.title: Unified galaxy power spectrum measurements from 6dFGS, BOSS, and eBOSS
arxiv-2106-06324.creator: Patrick McDonald
arxiv-2106-06324.description: Abstract We make use of recent developments in the analysis of galaxy redshift surveys to present an easy to use matrix-based analysis framework for the galaxy power spectrum multipoles, including wide-angle effects and the survey window function. We employ this framework to derive the deconvolved power spectrum multipoles of 6dFGS DR3, BOSS DR12 and the eBOSS DR16 quasar sample.

arxiv-2206-06521.title: Ultra-High-Precision Detection of Single Microwave Photons based on a Hybrid System between Majorana Zero Mode and a Quantum Dot
arxiv-2206-06521.creator: Eric Chatterjee, Wei Pan, Daniel Soh
arxiv-2206-06521.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Eric Chatterjee, Wei Pan, Daniel Soh. The ability to detect single photons has become increasingly essential due to the rise of photon-based quantum computing. In this theoretical work, we propose a system consisting of a quantum dot (QD) side-coupled to a superconducting nanowire. The coupling opens a gap in both the QD mode and the Majorana zero mode (MZM) at the nanowire edge, enabling photon absorption in the system.

arxiv-2209-07442.title: Automatic Error Analysis for Document-level Information Extraction
arxiv-2209-07442.creator: Aliva Das, Xinya Du, Barry Wang Kejian Shi, Jiayuan Gu, Thomas Porter, Claire Cardie Department of Computer Science, Cornell University {ad677, xd75, zw545, ks2325, jg844, tjp78, ctc9}@cornell.edu
arxiv-2209-07442.description: Abstract Document-level information extraction (IE) tasks have recently begun to be revisited in earnest using the end-to-end neural network techniques that have been successful on their sentence-level IE counterparts. Evaluation of the approaches, however, has been limited in a number of dimensions. In particular, the precision/recall/F1 scores typically reported provide few insights on the range of errors the models make.

arxiv-2303-08901.title: Learning to Concentrate: Multi-tracer Forecasts on Local Primordial Non-Gaussianity with Machine-Learned Bias
arxiv-2303-08901.creator: Uroš Seljak
arxiv-2303-08901.description: Abstract Local primordial non-Gaussianity (LPNG) is predicted by many non-minimal models of inflation, and creates a scale-dependent contribution to the power spectrum of large-scale structure (LSS) tracers, whose amplitude is characterized by b ϕ b_{\phi} . Knowledge of b ϕ b_{\phi} for the observed tracer population is therefore crucial for learning about inflation from LSS.

arxiv-2404-12612.title: SA-Attack: Speed-adaptive stealthy adversarial attack on trajectory prediction
arxiv-2404-12612.creator: Huilin Yin, Jiaxiang Li, Pengju Zhen, Jun Yan
arxiv-2404-12612.description: Abstract Trajectory prediction is critical for the safe planning and navigation of automated vehicles. The trajectory prediction models based on the neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Previous attack methods have achieved high attack success rates but overlook the adaptability to realistic scenarios and the concealment of the deceits.

arxiv-2408-05436.title: A Methodological and Structural Review of Hand Gesture Recognition Across Diverse Data Modalities
arxiv-2408-05436.creator: ABU SALEH MUSA MIAH 1 , (IEEE MEMBER), JUNGPIL SHIN 1 ,(SENIOR IEEE MEMBER) MD. HUMAUN KABIR 2, MD. ABDUR RAHIM 3, ABDULLAH AL SHIAM 4
arxiv-2408-05436.description: Abstract Researchers have been developing Hand Gesture Recognition (HGR) systems to enhance natural, efficient, and authentic human-computer interaction, especially benefiting those who rely solely on hand gestures for communication. Despite significant progress, the automatic and precise identification of hand gestures remains a considerable challenge in computer vision.

arxiv-2411-08110.title: Characterising memory in quantum channel discrimination via constrained separability problems
arxiv-2411-08110.creator: Ties-A. Ohst, Shijun Zhang, Hai Chau Nguyen, Martin Plávala, Marco Túlio Quintino
arxiv-2411-08110.description: Abstract Quantum memories are a crucial precondition in many protocols for processing quantum information. A fundamental problem that illustrates this statement is given by the task of channel discrimination, in which an unknown channel drawn from a known random ensemble should be determined by applying it for a single time.

arxiv-2412-02487.title: Black holes and covariance in effective quantum gravity: A solution without Cauchy horizons
arxiv-2412-02487.creator: Cong Zhang, Jerzy Lewandowski, Yongge Ma, Jinsong Yang
arxiv-2412-02487.description: Abstract The issue of general covariance in effective quantum gravity models within the Hamiltonian framework is addressed. The previously proposed equations for the covariance condition in spherically symmetric models are explicitly derived. By solving this equation, a new effective Hamiltonian constraint is obtained, incorporating free functions that can account for quantum gravity effects.

arxiv-2601-21235.title: SHARP: Social Harm Analysis via Risk Profiles for Measuring Inequities in Large Language Models
arxiv-2601-21235.creator: Alok Abhishek, Tushar Bandopadhyay, Lisa Erickson
arxiv-2601-21235.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, where rare but severe failures can result in irreversible harm. However, prevailing evaluation benchmarks often reduce complex social risk to mean-centered scalar scores, thereby obscuring distributional structure, cross-dimensional interactions, and worst-case behavior.

pmc-10735805.title: INDIVIDUAL AND COUNTY-LEVEL FACTORS OF SERVICE USE BY DEMENTIA FAMILY CAREGIVERS IN RURAL APPALACHIA
pmc-10735805.creator: Suyoung Nah, Tina Savla, Karen Roberto
pmc-10735805.description: Formal services have been shown to provide health benefits for care recipients and family caregivers. Despite prior efforts, it is still unclear which factors play a role in the decisions to use formal services by family caregivers living in under-resourced rural regions.

pmc-11455335.title: 5116 Postmenopausal Hyperandrogenism due to Rare Ovarian Tumor
pmc-11455335.creator: Michael Salim, Sandhyarani Dasaraju, Yee Liong Lee, Soha Afzal, Britt K Erickson, Mahmoud A Khalifa, Lynn Ann Burmeister
pmc-11455335.description: Disclosure: M. Salim: None. S. Dasaraju: None. Y. Lee: None. S. Afzal: None. B.K. Erickson: None. M.A. Khalifa: None. L.A. Burmeister: None. Background: Hyperandrogenism in postmenopausal women may arise from either ovarian or adrenal source and can pose challenging diagnostic dilemma. Clinical Case: A 66-year-old multigravida, post-menopausal woman presented with a 3-month history of worsening alopecia.

pmc-11600821.title: Comparisons of efficacy and safety of 400 or 800 ml bacterial count fecal microbiota transplantation in the treatment of recurrent hepatic encephalopathy: a multicenter prospective randomized controlled trial in China
pmc-11600821.creator: Pengfei Zou, Yunjiao Bi, Zhaowei Tong, Tao Wu, Qiang Li, Kai Wang, Yuchen Fan, Dan Zhao, Xin Wang, Hui Shao, Haijun Huang, Suping Ma, Yunsong Qian, Guoqiang Zhang, Xiao Liu, Qiaofei Jin, Qingjing Ru, Zhiping Qian, Wei Sun, Qiang Chen, Liying You, Fang Wang, Xiaoting Zhang, ZhenXiong Qiu, Qing Lin, J
pmc-11600821.description: BackgroundHepatic encephalopathy (HE) represents a critical complications of end-stage liver disease, serving as an independent predictor of mortality among patients with cirrhosis. Despite effective treatment with rifaximin, some patients with HE still progress to recurrent episodes, posing a significant therapeutic challenge. Recurrent HE is defined as experiencing two or more episodes within a 6-month period.

pmc-12472069.title: Eco-Gypsum Panels with Recycled Fishing NET Fibers for Sustainable Construction: Development and Characterization
pmc-12472069.creator: Leonardo Lima, Alicia Zaragoza-Benzal, Daniel Ferrández, Paulo Santos, Abbas Solouki, Abir Al-Tabbaa
pmc-12472069.description: Plastic waste is currently a major environmental issue but also plays a key role in the circular economy. Recycled plastics have become suitable for use in several applications, especially in construction, where they can improve the properties of conventional materials to enable sustainable development.

pmc-12473637.title: Receiver Location Optimization for Heterogeneous S-Band Marine Transmitters in Passive Multistatic Radar Networks via NSGA-II
pmc-12473637.creator: Xinpeng Li, Pengfei He, Jie Song, Zhongxun Wang
pmc-12473637.description: Comprehensive maritime domain awareness is crucial for navigation safety, traffic management, and security surveillance. In the context of an increasingly complex modern electromagnetic environment, the disadvantages of traditional active single-station radars, such as their high cost and susceptibility to interference, have started to surface.

pmc-12646640.title: ZIPcnv: accurate and efficient inference of copy number variations from shallow whole-genome sequencing
pmc-12646640.creator: Zhengfa Xue, Jingyu Zeng, Xuwen Wang, Jiajing Yuan, Tianci Wang, Xin Lai, Lin Wang, Yu Wang, Huanhuan Zhu, Xin Jin, Jiayin Wang
pmc-12646640.description: MotivationShallow whole-genome sequencing (sWGS), a rapid and cost-effective sequencing technology, has gradually been widely adopted for CNV analyses. However, with genome‑wide coverage of only 0.1–5×, sWGS data display a pronounced zero‑inflation phenomenon—a large fraction of loci has zero sequencing reads. Zero inflation causes read counts to fluctuate by several‑fold between adjacent windows.

pmc-12975841.title: The role of the FT3/FT4 ratio in predicting remission and relapse in pediatric Graves’ disease
pmc-12975841.creator: Leyla Kara, Ulku Gul Siraz, Dilek Cicek, Emre Sarikaya, Ebru Gok, Ugur Berber, Mustafa Kendirci, Selim Kurtoğlu, Nihal Hatipoglu
pmc-12975841.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Long-term antithyroid drug (ATD) therapy is often required in pediatric Graves’ disease, yet adherence can be challenging. Therefore, identifying reliable predictors of remission and relapse is crucial for optimizing disease management. This study aimed to evaluate the role of the baseline FT3/FT4 ratio in predicting remission and relapse, alongside other potential markers, including TRAb levels, thyroid volume, and body mass index (BMI). This retrospective, single-center study included pediatric patients diagnosed with Graves’ disease and treated with ATDs.

pmc-13199510.title: Enrichment of T: A→A: T substitutions in the TP53 gene in esophageal carcinoma with high Fusobacterium burden
pmc-13199510.creator: Tomomitsu Tahara, Takuya Shijimaya, Jumpei Yamazaki, Tsubasa Shimogama, Sanshiro Kobayashi, Naohiro Nakamura, Yu Takahashi, Takashi Tomiyama, Toshiro Fukui, Tomoyuki Shibata, Makoto Naganuma
pmc-13199510.description: Exogenous lifestyle and environmental risk factors impact mutation burden in both benign and cancerous tissues. Moreover, interactions between the mucosa-associated microbiome and such genotoxic changes have been implicated in several cancer types. This study aimed to characterize the TP53 mutation spectrum in esophageal carcinoma (EC) with high amounts of Fusobacterium species.

pmc-13259595.title: A pilot randomized clinical trial of gamification to increase medication adherence
pmc-13259595.creator: Alexander C Fanaroff, Kayla Clark, Leslie Reid-Bey, Charles Rareshide, Jingsan Zhu, Laurie Norton, Kevin G Volpp
pmc-13259595.description: IntroductionMedication nonadherence is a key contributor to poor control of cardiovascular risk factors, but most interventions shown to increase adherence are labor-intensive and have not been implemented widely. Gamification interventions informed by behavioral economic theory increase physical activity with minimal cost and personnel requirements.

pmc-13312315.title: Interfacial stability in single- and multi-junction perovskite solar cells
pmc-13312315.creator: Liangchen Qian, Bohong Chang, Danpeng Gao, Bo Li, Zonglong Zhu
pmc-13312315.description: Perovskite photovoltaics offer high efficiencies and low costs, with single- and multi-junction cells showing immense future potential. Yet, their operational stability remains a key bottleneck that is increasingly rooted at interfaces. In this review, we analyze interfaces as metastable chemical microenvironments characterized by high defect densities, steep chemical potential gradients, localized electric fields, and mechanical stress.

pmc-13342444.title: Integrated geophysical, geological, and machine learning approach for structural characterization of the Balakot-Bagh fault zone associated with the 2005 Mw 7.6 Kashmir earthquake
pmc-13342444.creator: Shahab Noor, Muhammad Younis Khan, Syed Ali Turab, Yonatan Garkebo Doyoro, Chih-Ping Lin, Muhammad Farooq
pmc-13342444.description: Active fault reactivation poses significant hazards, and understanding their near-surface structure is crucial for mitigating seismic risk. Along the Balakot-Bagh fault (BBF), the source of the 2005 Mw 7.6 Kashmir earthquake, geomorphic evidence is gradually eroded and sedimented. Traditional Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) often produces smoothly varying tomograms that obscure sharp structural boundaries.

pmc-13557295.title: Childhood Rosacea: Clinical, Diagnostic, and Therapeutic Insights into an Underestimated Pediatric Condition
pmc-13557295.creator: Vincenzo Piccolo, Julia Nowowiejska-Purpurowicz, Andrea Bassi, Dirk Van Gysel, Alex Alexopoulos, Talia Kakourou, Caterina Mariarosaria Giorgio, Giuseppe Argenziano
pmc-13557295.description: IntroductionRosacea is a very frequent skin disease; however, its prevalence in children is underestimated, and there are not enough data on this dermatosis in the pediatric population.ObjectiveThis study aimed to give comprehensive insight into childhood rosacea (CR), pointing out predisposing factors, clinical presentation, diagnostic clues, and therapy of this subgroup of the disease spectrum.

pmc-13679197.title: Healthcare professionals and relatives in shaping the preferred place of end-of-life care and death for patients with advanced cancer: the WhereToCare qualitative study
pmc-13679197.creator: Amandine Ferreux, Léon Breuillot, Florent Schepens, Florence Mathieu-Nicot, Mathilde Giffard
pmc-13679197.description: BackgroundAlthough most people in France wish to die at home, the majority of deaths still occur in hospitals. The choices of end-of-life care for patients with advanced cancer and how these preferences are shaped by interactions with relatives and healthcare professionals, remains poorly understood.
